metadata.query: evangelion style UI design dark red interface

frame.notes: Reference warning banners are thick rounded rectangles (~3-4px vision-measured stroke) on pure black fill. TWO-TONE system: orange variant (border #b77920, title text #ffaa00, thin lighter amber inner keyline) for PSYCHOGRAPHIC DISPLAY / INTERNAL; red variant (border #e32200, title text #ff3300, thin red inner keyline) for APPROACHING LIMITS / DANGER. Strong outer neon glow in the border's own hue; radius 10-15px.

cards.notes: Every element in the reference is its own closed rounded box: near-black fill, 2px orange border, lighter amber inner keyline, moderate orange glow, uppercase neon title. eDEX granularity: per-widget WidgetSection boxes. The featured hex-grid container uses the RED variant instead (3px #ff3300, radius 12, strong red glow).

dividers.notes: No internal divider lines exist in the reference. Separation is achieved by black gaps (hex grid inter-cell gaps measure near-black #080000-#120000, 6-8px wide) and by the hazard-stripe block. Use dark #1a1b20 hairlines only where the eDEX structure structurally requires a rule.

inputs.notes: No input fields are present in the reference; derived from the frame language as a quiet dark-red 1px rounded border, no glow.

activeIndicators.notes: Left accent bar on active items, klaxon red with moderate glow, matching the neon keyline language.

regions.name: warning banner row (PSYCHOGRAPHIC DISPLAY orange / APPROACHING LIMITS red)
INTERNAL id card with vertical hazard-stripe block (left column)
DANGER banner (right column, below APPROACHING LIMITS)
glowing red hexagonal warning grid (right/center, dominant element)
gray #2a2c32 structural chrome between black panels

keyElements.description: Thick rounded neon rectangle, black fill, 3-4px border with lighter inner keyline, uppercase glowing title with heavy dark outline
INTERNAL identification card: huge 内部 glyphs in orange/gold with black outline + glow, INTERNAL label, vertical hazard-stripe block on its right edge
Diagonal ~45° stripes, bright red-pink #ff2533 alternating with very dark red/black gaps, ~35-45px band width, clipped inside the orange card frame
18 visible glowing red-orange hexagons in staggered rows; fill #ff3300 with darker facet shading, near-black #080000-#120000 gaps 6-8px, strong diffuse red glow, no outer frame
DANGER / APPROACHING LIMITS banners: red variant frame, vivid orange-red glowing title

animations.plan: Featured hex grid: staggered per-cell opacity blink (klaxon flicker), opacity-only keyframes; DANGER banner title glow pulse via opacity on a glow layer. No rotations, no layout-affecting properties.

measurements.note: analyze-ui row-scan border (#3d3d3d, 1px) is a gray-chrome transition artifact; the vision-described 3-4px neon frame governs.
